Hi David Martinez,

I'm Prashant Biswas from Ganit. We are a full-stack Data & AI company, recognized by Everest, Forrester, and Analytics India.

With Snowflake's AI usage accelerating across 9,800+ customer organizations and your team in Bozeman managing a multi-cloud Spark and Kubernetes stack under 4.4% headcount growth, the pressure to hold data freshness SLAs and keep warehouse costs in check — without linearly scaling your engineering headcount — is a real constraint at your scale.

We help data engineering teams at high-volume platforms reduce pipeline toil and improve engineer-to-data ratios by building reliable, cost-efficient Snowflake Lakehouse architectures that scale without proportional infrastructure spend.

For one CPG company, we built a holistic AWS Data Lake + Snowflake Lakehouse integrating SAP, Salesforce, and other source systems into a scalable three-tier data lake (raw, curated, refined) — eliminating the ad-hoc pipeline sprawl that compounds exactly at the scale Snowflake is at now.

Would a focused 20-minute call this week or next make sense to explore whether there's a fit for your current data engineering priorities?

With regards,
Ganit team
